summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing completed for ReviewBoost MVP. All 18 backend API tests passed (auth, places CRUD, public review endpoints, analytics). Full UI flow verified end-to-end: landing page, admin login (invalid + valid), dashboard stats, add place form (with category select and all fields), places list, place detail (QR code SVG, preview link, regenerate reviews), public /r/:slug review page (auto scan tracking, copy-to-clipboard with visual feedback, sticky Google CTA), delete place, logout. Reviews are MOCKED using template-based generation as expected.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] combined with allow_credentials=True is invalid per CORS spec; most browsers reject credential requests from wildcard origins. Currently works only because frontend uses Bearer token header (not cookie). Recommend setting explicit FRONTEND_URL origin.
No brute-force lockout (playbook recommends lockout after 5 failed attempts). Acceptable for MVP but flagged.
Dead code: `frontend_url = os.environ.get('FRONTEND_URL', ...)` is read but never used in CORS config.

issues: Unused constant FRONTEND_URL defined but never referenced - dead code.
JWT stored in localStorage (XSS risk). Since backend already sets httpOnly cookies, the code could rely on cookies only and drop localStorage token. Low priority.

action_items: Consider replacing CORS allow_origins=['*'] with explicit FRONTEND_URL (or list of allowed origins) to correctly work with allow_credentials=True.
Remove dead code: unused `frontend_url` variable in server.py and unused FRONTEND_URL constant in AdminPlaces.js.
(Future) Implement brute-force lockout per auth playbook.
(Future) Consider relying on httpOnly cookies only and dropping localStorage token to reduce XSS risk.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfiguration: wildcard origin + credentials=True is technically broken for cookie-based auth in browsers. Works today only because frontend sends Bearer token header.
Mock AI reviews are clearly labeled and template-based (random.sample + rating 4-5). Ready to swap for real LLM integration.
Good: bcrypt password hashing, seed_admin is idempotent AND updates password if changed, httpOnly cookies, MongoDB _id is properly stripped from all responses.
Good: all interactive elements have data-testid; routes properly protected via ProtectedRoute component; unique slug generation uses secrets.token_hex (collision-safe).
seed_data_creation: Tests create and delete TEST_-prefixed places; no persistent seed data left over. One 'Grand Palace Hotel' place created earlier by main agent remains in DB (pre-existing, not from this test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is stable and covers auth, CRUD, public endpoints, analytics (18 tests, all passing). Admin login: admin@reviewboost.com / admin123. BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All data-testid selectors verified working. Mock AI review generation is intentional. CORS wildcard+credentials is the only notable (non-blocking) concern.
rca of the issue: No bugs to RCA - all tested functionality works as designed.
